comparison.objective: Probe an opaque duct, locate its blockage, mark the location, and withdraw the rod.
comparison.physical_skill: Flexible-rod feeding, force-based localization, measurement transfer, and extraction.
comparison.success_condition: Marker within 2 cm of the blockage and rod fully withdrawn for full credit.
comparison.reason: Blind probing and localization do not test a lockable angular stop or functional retention.
